title: Hyperian
survival_class: SURVIVAL DIFFICULTY CLASS 4; Exit: 4/5 Very Difficult to Exit; Environment: 3/5 High Environmental Risk; Entities: 5/5 Hostile Infestation
physical_identity: A large island civilisation ringed by cliffs and mountains in a vast hazardous ocean; wooden towns, farms, a central trade hub (Hyperia), unique red-trunk white-leaf trees.
scale_topology: Island of 2 166 000 km2, mountains ~56% of landmass; surrounded by lethal ocean; outer circle and mountain-protected inner circle.
anomalies: pale pink sky with everlasting sun
lighting_sound: Pale pink sky with a permanent sun at the sea; rainbows over hills; surf and village life implied, not detailed.

entities.name: The Kraken
entities.behavior: Sleeps deep offshore; magnetic whirlpool traps boats

entities.name: ~200 ocean entities
entities.behavior: Estimated unique ocean entities, none documented

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: the Kraken offshore; unnamed ocean entities as reports; no land entities named
hazards: mountain terrain and coast lethal temperatures

entrances.method: Sail far beyond the ocean until pale pink sky
entrances.quote: one must traverse far beyond Level 7
Alternatively you can enter via an arcade machine on Level 25

exits.method: Sail several days away from the island
exits.quote: all attempts result in the death of the wanderers
one would theoretically end up in Level 114 or Level 284

signature_mechanic: Safe civilised island enclosed by an ocean that kills any ship; the only exit is nearly impossible.
verticality: Mountain belt and hill watchtowers; no towers.
do_not: place the Kraken near the island
conflicts_notes: Banner: page being rewritten. Footnotes 1-3 missing. Header says 5/5 Hostile Infestation but only the Kraken and unnamed ocean entities are described. Page calls it the 30th level.
